name: Standard Income Statement — Manufacturing
description: Target account taxonomy for spreading a manufacturing company income statement. Leaf accounts receive mapped line items. Total accounts aggregate children and are checked by validation rules.

accounts.name: Product Revenue
accounts.description: Revenue from the sale of manufactured goods and products.

accounts.name: Service Revenue
accounts.description: Revenue from services rendered to customers.

accounts.name: Other Revenue
accounts.description: Licensing fees, royalties, and miscellaneous operating revenue.

accounts.name: Total Revenue
accounts.description: Sum of all revenue streams.

accounts.name: Raw Materials
accounts.description: Cost of raw materials and supplies consumed in production.

accounts.name: Direct Labor
accounts.description: Wages paid directly to production workers. Includes production payroll.

accounts.name: Manufacturing Overhead
accounts.description: Indirect production costs: factory rent, equipment maintenance, production supervision.

accounts.name: Other Direct Costs
accounts.description: Freight, shipping, packaging, and other costs directly tied to goods sold.

accounts.name: Total Cost of Goods Sold
accounts.description: Sum of all direct costs of producing goods sold.

accounts.name: Gross Profit
accounts.description: Revenue minus cost of goods sold.

accounts.name: Selling, General & Administrative
accounts.description: Non-production operating expenses: salaries (non-production), benefits, rent, marketing, professional fees, insurance, utilities, office supplies, travel, bad debt.

accounts.name: Research & Development
accounts.description: Expenditures on research and new product development.

accounts.name: Depreciation & Amortization
accounts.description: Non-cash charges for depreciation of tangible assets and amortization of intangibles.

accounts.name: Total Operating Expenses
accounts.description: Sum of SGA, R&D, and D&A.

accounts.name: Operating Income
accounts.description: Gross profit minus total operating expenses.

accounts.name: Interest Expense
accounts.description: Cost of borrowed funds.

accounts.name: Interest Income
accounts.description: Income earned from interest-bearing instruments.

accounts.name: Other Non-Operating Income/Expense
accounts.description: Gains/losses on asset sales, FX, warranty adjustments, and other non-operating items.

accounts.name: Pre-Tax Income
accounts.description: Income before provision for income taxes.

accounts.name: Income Tax Expense
accounts.description: Provision for federal, state, and local income taxes.

accounts.name: Net Income
accounts.description: Bottom-line profit after all expenses and taxes.

accounts.name: Extraordinary Items
accounts.description: Unusual, infrequent items not part of normal operations. Rarely used.
